title: tourism example: Unable to get results if price range is narrowed before query
body:
I first do a narrow search on the price range, then do a search query. After that the map is centered somewhere (?) and I cannot move the price range anymore.

![2015-11-17_16h00m42](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/283419/11215108/eb906326-8d44-11e5-8d8e-43351f28b6e7.gif)

Not sure if this is an example issue or a price range one.

https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/examples/tourism/

comments.body: @vvo isn't that an implementation bug in the widget? How to solve that?
Yes most probably an issue in the rangeSlider widget indeed. Did not have a look.
I can reproduce the same wrong behavior by pushing one of the handle on top of the other.

I believe we need to add something to our own default css file as @bobylito proposed. But we can also have a look at how http://refreshless.com/nouislider/ does it, this is the slider we use, maybe we stripped too many CSS from their original file.

http://refreshless.com/nouislider/ do not have any issue with overlapping handles. If we find how did they do it, it would be cool

Well actually I just tried the first demo on the website and it does overlap. BUT the last moved handle is on the foreground, our problem is that instantsearch moves the handles programmatically making it impossible to nouislider to know which handle should be in the foreground (and so we may have handles that can't be moved because they are blocked by one another).

IMHO nouislider is failing on the usability aspect by having this overlap and so we should add the CSS :)
